# opnsense_quagga_ospf6_routemap (Data Source)

Reads one OPNsense OSPFv3 route-map entry by UUID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the route-map entry.

### Read-Only

- `action` (String) Whether this route-map entry permits or denies matching routes.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this route-map entry is enabled.
- `name` (String) Name of the route map.
- `prefix_lists` (Set of String) UUIDs of prefix-list entries matched by this route-map entry.
- `route_map_id` (Number) Route-map sequence ID.
- `set` (String) FRR route-map set expression.
